This information, shared with Parliament by the Minister of State for Finance, highlights the growing obligations faced by trusts, political organizations, and academic institutions submitting ITR-7.

items.summary: The Airbus A320, carrying 137 passengers and eight crew, lost around 300 feet (91 metres) on August 4 while flying from Phuket in Thailand to New Delhi, before stabilising and landing safely.

items.title: Don't worry about AI! Why PPFAS CIO Rajeev Thakkar wants Indian investors to read what tech analyst Benedict Evans said
items.summary: PPFAS CIO Rajeev Thakkar says fears that AI will destroy IT jobs are exaggerated. Citing Benedict Evans and historical automation, he argues technology eliminates some roles while creating new work, with implementation, cybersecurity and other opportunities emerging.

items.title: Can SIFs bridge the gap between mutual funds and alternative investments?
items.summary: Specialized Investment Funds (SIFs) introduced a new investment framework for experienced investors. As portfolios evolve beyond traditional asset classes, could SIFs become the missing link between mutual funds and alternative investments?

items.summary: Oil extended its recent rebound after President Donald Trump made sweeping new demands on Iran, further clouding the outlook for a deal to reopen the crucial Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Air India outgoing CEO summoned over Phuket-Delhi flight's altitude loss: Report
items.summary: India's aviation ministry summoned Air India's outgoing CEO regarding a recent flight incident. The aircraft experienced a sudden altitude loss, causing passenger and crew injuries. Multiple technical issues and turbulence were reported during the flight. Investigators are examining the serious incident with international assistance. Confirmatory test results for the pilot-in-command are currently awaited.

items.title: PM E-DRIVE scheme to run till Mar 31, 2028; electric two-wheeler incentive capped at Rs 5,000
items.summary: In a strategic move to encourage electric vehicle usage, the government has prolonged the PM E-DRIVE Scheme until March 2028, though incentives for electric two-wheelers will be cut down to Rs 2,500 per kWh effective from April 1, 2025. The initiative carries a substantial funding of Rs 11,900 crore, focusing on both vehicle adoption and necessary infrastructure expansion.

items.title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex drops 388 pts, Nifty slips to 24,471 on surging crude oil prices
items.summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Indian equities remained under pressure on Tuesday as elevated crude oil prices weighed on sentiment, despite stronger corporate earnings and renewed foreign portfolio inflows. Investors also tracked geopolitical risks, Adani Group stocks and upcoming changes to the Nifty 50.

items.title: Intel raises $20 billion from upsized share sale: Where the money will go?
items.summary: Intel raised $20 billion in a share sale, exceeding its initial $15 billion goal, with a share price of $95. The offering drew over $100 billion in demand as Intel invests heavily to compete in contract chip manufacturing amid strong customer demand for AI technologies.

items.title: Godrej Consumer Products appoints Aasif Malbari as CEO, replacing Sudhir Sitapati
items.summary: With the appointment of Aasif Malbari as the new managing director and chief executive officer, a transition is underway at the helm. He takes over from Sudhir Sitapati, who departs after five impactful years. Malbari, who was serving as GCPL’s global chief financial officer, brings significant experience from the FMCG and automotive sectors, focusing on strengthening core business operations and fast-tracking the expansion of new categories.

items.title: Fusion Finance aims to cut microfin share, offer larger retail loans
items.summary: Fusion Finance plans to reduce microfinance loans to seventy percent by fiscal 2029. The company will introduce larger individual loans while focusing on small business lending. Assets under management aim to reach ten thousand crore rupees this fiscal year. This diversification follows regulatory changes allowing more non-microfinance loan options.

items.title: Global Market: European shares edge higher as energy stocks gain on Middle East uncertainty
items.summary: European shares edged higher as energy stocks gained on elevated oil prices amid Middle East tensions. Investors remained cautious ahead of key euro zone and U.S. economic data that could influence inflation, growth and interest-rate expectations.

items.summary: On August 11, the Indian stock market faced pressure with the Nifty 50 down 0.54% and Sensex declining 0.50%. Crude oil price rises and geopolitical tensions impacted sentiment, despite gains in pharma and technology stocks as mutual fund inflows weakened by 14.8% in July.

items.title: Rupee retreats to near two-week low, closes at 95.43 vs USD as US-Iran standoff pushes oil higher
items.summary: The Indian rupee tumbled to a two-week low on Tuesday as surging oil prices and waning optimism regarding a U.S.-Iran deal pressured the currency. The Reserve Bank of India stepped in to mitigate the rupee's decline, yet both the Nifty 50 and benchmark bonds experienced downturns. Attention is now on the impending inflation reports from India and the U.S. for further market cues.

items.summary: The dueling positions Washington and Tehran staked out showed how far apart the two sides remain even as both talked of winding down regional hostilities.

items.title: GDP is still the GOAT of economic statistics despite its many flaws
items.summary: The Gross Domestic Product serves as a key indicator of a country's economic status, highlighting overall production. While it may not be perfect, there's a strong connection between GDP and quality of life measures. Detractors, such as political figures, often propose different metrics, yet none have gained significant traction. In the end, GDP serves as a fundamental tool for assessing economic vitality and national living standards.

items.summary: The current Nifty-gold ratio of 1.6 signals a potential equities rebound, although experts advise maintaining investments in both gold and stocks. Consolidation may occur before equities outperform gold in the long term.

items.title: Hotel giant says ‘growing middle class’ boosted hotel demand despite Middle East hit
items.summary: IHG reported higher first-half profit as U.S. demand accelerated and Middle East disruption weighed on travel.

items.title: High crude prices drive Q1 surge for ONGC and OIL, but output growth diverges
items.summary: Stronger crude realizations boosted Q1 profits for both state explorers, but while Oil India expanded output, ONGC’s persistent production decline continues to weigh on its outlook.

items.title: KPI Green Energy Q1 Results: Net profit dips 14% at Rs 95 crore
items.summary: KPI Green Energy experienced a fourteen percent dip in net profit for the June quarter, signaling the effects of geopolitical tensions and rising costs on financing and depreciation. Despite this, the company reported a notable sixteen percent increase in total revenue, amounting to Rs 710 crore. Additionally, Kapil Kriplani has been appointed as the new Chief Financial Officer, following Salim Yahoo's resignation from the role.

items.title: Instamart expands Northeast sourcing, brings Meghalaya pineapples to Bengaluru
items.summary: Instamart is expanding its fresh produce sourcing network across Northeast India. Meghalaya's pineapples are now available to customers in Bengaluru through this initiative. This plan aims to create new markets for farmers and FPOs in the region. The company is exploring sourcing other GI-tagged products from various Northeast states.

items.title: Zydus Lifesciences Q1 Results: Net profit down 36% at Rs 939.8 crore
items.summary: Zydus Lifesciences reported a significant year-on-year decline of thirty-six percent in net profit for the first quarter, despite a robust twenty-two percent increase in operational revenue, reaching eight thousand seventeen crore rupees. The company experienced profitability challenges with an EBITDA reduction of seven point six percent compared to the previous year. Following the announcement, their stock price saw an uptick. Zydus is a prominent player in the global pharmaceutical landscape.

items.title: Siemens Q1 Results: Net profit declines 18% to Rs 343 crore
items.summary: Siemens Ltd reported a decline in net profit of over eighteen percent in the June quarter, largely due to fluctuating commodity prices and rising material costs. On a positive note, the company experienced a significant increase in operational revenue, underlining strong demand. Additionally, new orders surged, particularly within the Smart Infrastructure segment, driven by robust investments from both private and public sectors.

items.title: U.S. judge ends graft case against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani
items.summary: A U.S. federal judge has approved the Department of Justice's decision to dismiss the criminal probe against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani on graft charges.

items.title: India sixth-largest economy at $3.92 trillion nominal GDP in FY26: Government
items.summary: India's economy reached sixth globally with a $3.92 trillion GDP in 2025-26. Government strategies focus on agricultural productivity and manufacturing growth. Infrastructure and logistics are strengthened through public investment and new policies. Foreign investment remains substantial, and bank bad loans have significantly fallen. Unclaimed bank deposits now total over Rs 86,917 crore.

items.title: Philips India sees India emerging as global R&D, AI hub; bets on healthcare infrastructure for growth
items.summary: Philips India is focusing on growing healthcare infrastructure and artificial intelligence. The company's R&D footprint in India is significantly strengthening its global operations. Investments will continue to support Philips' positive growth story in the country. Philips sees opportunities in sleep and respiratory care as awareness increases. The company prioritizes value over price when facing competition from other firms.

items.title: Vodafone Idea secures Rs 6,400 crore in first funding tranche from SBI-led banks after AGR relief
items.summary: The telecom operator Vodafone Idea is in the process of raising capital from a mix of public sector and private lenders, showcasing significant advancement in its funding strategy. They have successfully closed the initial tranche amounting to Rs 6,400 crore, factoring in warrant proceeds and various debt facilities. The company remains engaged with lenders to fortify its overall financial health.

items.summary: Lilly's Foundayo wins U.K. approval, taking its weight-loss pill battle with Novo Nordisk's Wegovy beyond the U.S. market.

items.title: Ola Electric, Ather Energy shares surge up to 5% as EV subsidies extended to FY28
items.summary: Electric two-wheeler stocks surged by 5% on August 11 after the government extended subsidies under the PM E-Drive scheme until FY28, increasing the allocation to ₹11,900 crore. The number of eligible vehicles for subsidies rose to 4.57 million, boosting market sentiment.

items.title: Microfinance asset quality improves further as loans at risk fall to 2.3% in June: CRIF
items.summary: The microfinance sector experienced a noticeable easing of asset quality stress in June, thanks to lenders aggressively addressing bad loans, which bolstered the portfolio's performance. The average loan amounts saw an uptick as lenders prioritized dependable borrowers. Meanwhile, the seasonally driven slowdown caused loan origination to level off, although NBFC-MFIs recorded a significant increase in their portfolio shares over the past year.

items.title: RVNL Q1 results: Net profit up 18% YoY to ₹159 crore; revenue climbs nearly 11% YoY
items.summary: RVNL Q1 results: RVNL reported an 18.5% YoY increase in its consolidated net profit to ₹159.36 crore for Q1FY27. Revenue from operations for Q1FY27 stood at ₹4,321.23 crore, up 10.6% from ₹3,908.77 crore in Q1FY26.

items.summary: U.S. crude is back above $84 as last week's anticipation of a U.S.-Iran deal dissipates.

items.summary: The US Senate is moving to advance the Clarity Act, which aims to establish a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies. A key procedural vote is expected after the August recess, but the bill faces a 60-vote hurdle and resistance from Democrats seeking stronger safeguards.

items.title: RSWM, Spain's NDS9 form JV to set up Rs 186 crore premium apparel facility
items.summary: RSWM Ltd and Noize Design Studio have formed a joint venture for premium apparel. LNJ NDS9 Global Private Ltd will focus on denim and activewear for international brands. The new facility will integrate Industry 5.0 principles and advanced sustainable technologies. Initial investment is Rs 186 crore, with phased production capacity increases planned.

items.title: Apple Pay coming to India in October, UPI support may be delayed: Report
items.summary: Apple Pay may launch in India this October without UPI support. The service will initially use tokenized Visa and Mastercard credit cards. This allows iPhone and Apple Watch users contactless payment options. UPI integration is expected later due to ongoing technical discussions. Apple faces challenges adapting its global payment system to India's market.

items.title: Government approves introduction of one billion polymer banknotes of Rs 10 and 20
items.summary: The government has approved polymer banknotes for field trials and regular issuance. Inflation has declined steadily, though recent pressures exist. The Goods and Services Tax Council introduced a two-rate structure for goods. Customs duty and excise duty reductions aim to contain price pressures. Disposable income increased, supporting household consumption and economic growth.

items.title: Tribeca, Ira Realty to invest Rs 2,000 cr to build Trump-branded housing project in Hyderabad
items.summary: Tribeca Developers and Ira Realty will launch a Trump-branded luxury housing project in Hyderabad. This significant development involves an investment of approximately two thousand crore rupees. The project will feature two sixty-five-storey buildings with four hundred fifty apartments. It marks the Trump brand's first venture into South India.

items.title: SC ruling may widen motor insurance cover for vehicle occupants, pillion riders
items.summary: Motor insurance policyholders will receive broader occupant protection following a Supreme Court ruling. The court directed the insurance regulator to standardize policy wording for occupant and pillion rider covers. This move aims to bring greater clarity on passenger protection in accident claims. Insurers are assessing the impact of this ruling on motor claims costs. Separately, mandatory third-party insurance enforcement for new vehicles is being explored.

items.title: Intel’s $15 billion stock sale. Why shares fell despite AI boom
items.summary: Intel shares fell after the company announced the offering, as investors worried about share dilution

items.title: Wall Street giants hand Nvidia $500bn to fund boom in AI projects
items.summary: The money will be used to develop new data centres to house, operate, and cool miles of stacked computer chips that process AI data and actions.

items.summary: Fitch Ratings affirmed India’s BBB- long-term rating with a stable outlook and F3 short-term rating, saying macroeconomic stability and improving policy credibility will support growth despite near-term risks from the Middle East conflict.

items.title: Treasury yields up as oil prices jump and investors await inflation data
items.summary: U.S. Treasury yields edged higher Tuesday as investors await July's inflation data print amid ongoing Iran tensions.

The companies jointly applied for a lithium extraction license in Chile. Acquisition decisions will follow the license approval process. India seeks to reduce reliance on China-dominated mineral supply chains.

items.title: How Wipro's Nifty exit shows old warhorse Indian IT is losing charm
items.summary: Wipro’s exit from the Nifty 50 and BSE’s inclusion highlight the shifting composition of India’s benchmark index. The move comes as IT stocks face concerns over AI disruption and weakening investor interest. Wipro shares are down sharply in 2026, while the combined Nifty 50 weight of India’s top IT companies has fallen.

items.title: Goldman Sachs names Chandresh Chheda as co-head of India investment banking
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has appointed former JPMorgan executive Chandresh Chheda as managing director and co-head of India investment banking. His appointment comes as India’s IPO, ECM and M&A markets remain strong, with Goldman expanding its dealmaking franchise.

items.title: Equity MF inflows fall 15% to ₹24,697 cr in July
items.summary: The July data showed continued resilience in equity mutual fund investments, although the pace of inflows moderated from the previous month

items.summary: US officials are working to strengthen domestic manufacturing supply chains as foreign investment rises under President Donald Trump’s tariff and deregulation policies. Officials are seeking to help small and medium-sized suppliers expand capacity, speed up foreign investment reviews and rebuild US industrial capacity amid growing demand from overseas manufacturers.

items.title: 25-year-old hedge fund manager who lost $35 billion in a month eyes fresh capital after AI stock selloff

Despite the sharp losses, the 25-year-old fund manager is seeking fresh capital from existing backers. The episode highlights the risks of concentrated portfolios, heavy leverage and conviction-driven investing.

items.summary: Veteran investor Michael Burry said Berkshire Hathaway has lost its investment appeal after Warren Buffett’s succession, arguing that Greg Abel may lack Buffett’s patience for major opportunities. Burry also flagged concerns over Berkshire’s large cash pile, saying its recent moves appear more strategic than investment-focused.

items.title: Eternal helped you save time. Now it wants to help you spend it
items.summary: Eternal’s District is betting India’s next consumer internet boom will come from helping people spend time outside home. As dining, shopping, movies, sports and live events grow, District aims to become the digital layer for offline consumption. The strategy reflects a broader shift from convenience to experiences, while Eternal targets rising urban leisure spending and cross category engagement in India.
